'''Ook''' was a ten-foot [[Cragmoloid/Legends|Cragmoloid]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]].

Along with fellow Cragmoloid [[Noba]], Ook was kidnapped in Cragmoloid native [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ankus/Legends|Ankus]], and both of them soon ended in the slave "zoo" of slaver [[Phylus Mon]] (who could have kidnapped them in the first place). They had to learn [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] language during their imprisonment, and they reached an acceptable level. As of around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[A Mon Alone]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> after an unspecified time as slaves, both of them still suffered from homesickness.

The person in the next cell, [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Bin Kohal]], considered the size of Ook and Noba for a possible escape plan: The Cragmoloids were so big that they would take up a lot of space in any escape ship. A massive escape would have to include more than one ship.

Phylus Mon surgically inserted an explosive near the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of each of his slaves. The explosive would be activated in the case of Phylus Mon's [[Death/Legends|death]], but it could also be deactivated with the impact of an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion weapon]]. All the slaves in Phylus Mon's zoo were also regularly battered.
